# google_agent_registry_skill_revision

Represents an immutable, versioned snapshot of a Skill package.

## Example Usage - Agent Registry Skill Revision Basic


```hcl
resource "google_agent_registry_skill_revision" "default" {
  location          = "global"
  skill             = "private-tf-test-skill"
  skill_revision_id = "ar-rev"

  archive_upload_source {
    archive_content = ""
  }
}
```

## Example Usage - Agent Registry Skill Revision Gcs Source


```hcl
data "google_project" "project" {}

resource "google_storage_bucket" "bucket" {
  name                        = "ar-skill-bucket"
  location                    = "US"
  uniform_bucket_level_access = true
  force_destroy               = true
}

resource "google_storage_bucket_iam_member" "viewer" {
  bucket = google_storage_bucket.bucket.name
  role   = "roles/storage.objectViewer"
  member = "serviceAccount:service-${data.google_project.project.number}@gcp-sa-agentregistry.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
}

resource "google_storage_bucket_object" "archive" {
  name    = "skill.zip"
  bucket  = google_storage_bucket.bucket.name
  content = base64decode("UEsDBBQAAAAAAAAAIQBbV0s5OAAAADgAAAAIAAAAU0tJTEwubWQtLS0KbmFtZTogbXktdGVzdC1za2lsbApkZXNjcmlwdGlvbjogQSB0ZXN0IHNraWxsIDQKLS0tClBLAQIUAxQAAAAAAAAAIQBbV0s5OAAAADgAAAAIAAAAAAAAAAAAAQAAAAAAAABTS0lMTC5tZFBLBQYAAAAAAQABADYAAABeAAAAAAA=")
}

resource "google_agent_registry_skill_revision" "default" {
  location          = "global"
  skill             = "private-tf-test-skill"
  skill_revision_id = "ar-rev-gcs"

  gcs_source {
    uri        = "gs://${google_storage_bucket.bucket.name}/${google_storage_bucket_object.archive.name}"
    generation = google_storage_bucket_object.archive.generation
  }

  depends_on = [google_storage_bucket_iam_member.viewer]
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `location` -
  (Required)
  The location of the resource.

* `skill` -
  (Required)
  The parent Skill identifier.

* `skill_revision_id` -
  (Required)
  Custom, user-defined unique revision identifier. In Terraform, this field is required. Format: 4-63 characters, matching regex `^[a-z]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$`.


* `archive_upload_source` -
  (Optional)
  Direct write-only raw archive payload upload.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_archive_upload_source).

* `gcs_source` -
  (Optional)
  Specifications for Cloud Storage objects.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_gcs_source).

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


<a name="nested_archive_upload_source"></a>The `archive_upload_source` block supports:

* `archive_content` -
  (Required)
  Write-only raw ZIP/TAR archive payload bytes (base64-encoded) containing the skill package.

<a name="nested_gcs_source"></a>The `gcs_source` block supports:

* `uri` -
  (Required)
  Cloud Storage object URI. Format: `gs://{bucket_name}/{object_name}`

* `generation` -
  (Optional)
  Cloud Storage object generation ID. If not specified, the latest generation is used.

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/skills/{{skill}}/revisions/{{skill_revision_id}}`

* `name` -
  The resource name of the SkillRevision.
  Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/skills/{skill}/revisions/{revision}`

* `uid` -
  Universally unique identifier (UUID4) for the skill revision.

* `scan_result` -
  Scan result of the skill revision.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_scan_result).

* `size_bytes` -
  Size of the compiled zip payload in bytes (assists client download progress).

* `state` -
  The system-managed lifecycle state of this revision.

* `sha256_hash` -
  Cryptographic SHA-256 integrity and deduplication digest of the payload zip.

* `create_time` -
  Revision creation timestamp.

* `frontmatter` -
  Extracted YAML frontmatter configuration snapshot.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_frontmatter).


<a name="nested_scan_result"></a>The `scan_result` block contains:

* `scan_state` -
  (Output)
  The state of the vulnerability check.

* `scan_time` -
  (Output)
  The time when the scan was completed.

* `error_message` -
  (Output)
  The error message if the scan failed.

* `findings` -
  (Output)
  The finding resource names for the skill revision.

<a name="nested_frontmatter"></a>The `frontmatter` block contains:

* `name` -
  (Output)
  The name of the skill.

* `description` -
  (Output)
  Functional description.

* `license` -
  (Output)
  License.

* `compatibility` -
  (Output)
  Environmental dependencies or companion services.

* `metadata` -
  (Output)
  Extensible flattened map mapping custom tags, authors, and version parameters.

This resource provides the following

## Import


SkillRevision can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/skills/{{skill}}/revisions/{{skill_revision_id}}`
* `{{project}}/{{location}}/{{skill}}/{{skill_revision_id}}`
* `{{location}}/{{skill}}/{{skill_revision_id}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import SkillRevision using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    location = "<-required value->"
    skill = "<-required value->"
    skillRevisionId = "<-required value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_agent_registry_skill_revision.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import SkillRevision using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/skills/{{skill}}/revisions/{{skill_revision_id}}"
  to = google_agent_registry_skill_revision.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), SkillRevision can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_agent_registry_skill_revision.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/skills/{{skill}}/revisions/{{skill_revision_id}}
$ terraform import google_agent_registry_skill_revision.default {{project}}/{{location}}/{{skill}}/{{skill_revision_id}}
$ terraform import google_agent_registry_skill_revision.default {{location}}/{{skill}}/{{skill_revision_id}}
```
